Venusaur: Flamigo is my dedicated lead.  Brave Bird for general good damage, Low Sweep hits a lot of their team decently hard while allowing Flamigo and its teammates to outspeed them the following turn, Thief with no item allows it to cripple Tornadus-T and Moltres coming in for my cleaner Iron Treads, and Taunt stops a potential Araquanid lead from setting up Sticky Webs.  I don’t plan on terastallizing Flamigo, but just in case I need to deal with Excadrill, I have Tera Steel.  I tank Timid Tornadus-T Bleakwind Storm, outspeed it after a Low Sweep, and have 4 extra EVs in Attack.

Electrode has Thunderbolt and Volt Switch for self explanatory reasons.  Grass Knot is my choice in Grass STAB to be able to 2HKO Tyranitar in Sand, since OHKOing Gastrodon is not too important for it.  Foul Play with Tera Dark also threatens Gholdengo and Excadrill.  Tera Dark also helps deal with Bisharp’s Sucker Punch.  Speed outspeeds Tornadus-T, max Special Attack, rest in HP.

Qwilfish-Hisui’s job is to switch into Gholdengo and lay down hazards.  Spikes and Toxic Spikes help wear down Gastrodon and Tyranitar, Crunch is a useful STAB move and Aqua Jet might be useful against Sand Rush Excadrill.  Qwilfish has Defense for Araquanid, a little Speed creep, and then a Special Defense dump for Gholdengo.

Manaphy has a Red Card to help deal with Swords Dance Excadrill in Sand.  Take Heart and RestTalk also allows Manaphy to potentially sweep if given the opportunity, as long as they don’t have Storm Drain Gastrodon.  It also keeps Manaphy healthy to use its Defense investment to wall their physical attackers.  Scald is my STAB of choice to potentially burn big threats.  Manaphy has Speed for Tyranitar, rest in Defense.

Kleavor has Choice Scarf to both guarantee that I get Stealth Rocks up to chip down Salamence, Moltres, and Tornadus-Therian, especially since I plan on removing their Heavy-Duty Boots with Flamigo.  Stone Axe is self explanatory, Night Slash hits Gholdengo hard, Close Combat hits Tyranitar, Excadrill, and Bisharp pre Tera hard, and U-Turn is useful to pivot.  Speed for Gholdengo, max Attack, rest in HP.

Iron Treads is a great cleaner in this matchup.  Earthquake, Rock Slide, and Ice Spinner hits most of their team Super Effectively, and with Speed Booster Energy, I outspeed everything besides a Choice Scarf Tornadus-Therian and Excadrill in Sand.  Iron Defense is my last move which helps me tank hits from Tyranitar and Bisharp, along with helping me deal with Bisharp’s Sucker Punch.  Iron Treads has Speed for Salamence, max Attack, rest in HP.
